title: Ko Rewrude e Ñaawirde
intro: E nder koridoruuji laamu, limre toownde wonti jiɗɗo maccuɗo mo ŋarɗugol mum woni aduna goɗɗo. Ndee ɗoo yiɗde addani en waɗde geɗe keewɗe baɗɗe faayiida ngam ƴeewde nuunɗal, peeñnina goongaaji cuuɗiiɗi, haa joofna, tabitinde wonde maccuɗo oo alaa ko o waɗi.
clues: Mi hoɗii e leydi Niil, e nder galle laamorɗo mawɗo.
Suka gorko gooto ari e galle am, tawtoreede makko ina jiiɓi aduna am.
Mi etinooma fooɗtude mo, kono o ɗaɓɓi reentaade e joom makko.
Mi 6uuccii comci makko caggal, kono seedeeji ina kollita fenaande am.
Ngam silminde haala rewɓe tedduɓe ɓee, mi noddii ɓe e mooɓondiral, mi fawi heen geɗe ɓutte e juuɗe maɓɓe.
E joofnirde, mi jaɓii e yeeso yimɓe fof aybe am, mi jaɓii goonga e yeeso laamɗo.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: O wiyi ko o laamɗo debbo
O mahii suudu ngam luulndaade Alla
O ardii konu ngam haɓde e Makka

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: O waylitii o wonti piilngal lamɗam

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
